description: Roll out event schema versioning across a Kafka event streaming platform. Must: register Avro schemas in Schema Registry, configure backward compatibility checks, deploy schema version 2 for the 'order.created' event (added optional field), migrate producers to emit v2 events, migrate consumers to handle both v1 and v2, verify compatibility, and deprecate v1. Risk factors: schema compatibility check failing on non-additive changes, consumer not handling v2 causing deserialization errors, producer migration incomplete causing mixed versions. Tools available: Kafka, Avro, Schema Registry, kubectl, Python.
